verdict.rationale: Casium documents petition preparation and filing as its core service. It describes "a team preparing your petition in parallel" and says attorneys "file your visas" and "review and sign every filing," and it positions itself as a licensed law firm and service partner. It does not document the specific components the story names. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of evidence-binder assembly, drafting of expert/support letters, form preparation, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, the provider prepares the petition end to end — evidence binder, expert and support letters, forms, and filing — documented as its core service
